profileBody: Keep reality close. Collect the unexpected versions.
heroBody: Every version opens a world of your own.
empty: Your first scene is still to come.
emptyBody: Start with an image or a sentence. Your works will appear here.
creditBody: For 5-second video only. Image and text creation do not use video credits.
remix: Allow link remixes for new works
remixBody: Applies to new works only. Works stay private until you explicitly share a link.
accountBody: Your profile and preferences are stored by the server. Works are private by default.
helpBody: Works are private by default. Manage link sharing and remix permissions in work details. Production content review and staff processing are not configured. Local appeals only save records; they do not change export or sharing permission.
aboutBody: Give reality a twist. This China validation build offers private creation and version lineage, without a public community, tips, or earnings accounts.
loadError: Could not load account data. Please try again.
saveError: Your settings were not saved. Please retry.
videoSubtitle: One picture. An unexpected next scene.
source: Keep the characters and scene of this work
customPlaceholder: How would you like this scene to move?
unavailableBody: New video generation is unavailable. No credits are reserved or deducted. Motion choices are for planning only.
demoBody: This is a pre-made motion poster supplied with the design package, not a generated result for your current work. Viewing or downloading uses no credits.
balanceTitle:
Let the next great scene
happen now.
balanceSubtitle: Every second could start a new story
quotaNote: Balance comes from the server. A balance does not mean generation is available while the video service is disabled.
policyBody: Credits may be deducted only after successful video output. Failures, review rejection, and cancellation at a cancellable stage should not consume credits. Reset time and timezone come from the server; no estimated countdown is shown.
membershipBody: Future membership is intended to offer more video credits. Plans, pricing, and payments are not available yet.
faq1: Do image and text creations use video credits?
faq1Body: No. Video credits are separate from image and text creation. Creation availability depends on the configured service.
faq2Body: No plans are available for purchase, and no payment will be initiated.
loginCredits: Sign in to load your actual balance
settingsReadError: Could not load settings. Retry before making changes.
demoPlaybackError: This browser could not play the demo. Download the original video and open it in a supported player.
profileFailed: Profile was not saved. Please retry.
notificationNote: Only your preference is stored. No notification service is configured; no push or email is sent.
appealNote: Appeals are stored locally only. Staff processing is not configured; this does not start human review.
appealSaved: Local appeal saved. No staff processing is configured.
noOwnedWorks: Create a work before submitting an appeal about it.
motionSaved: Motion idea saved for this work
motionLoadFailed: Could not load this work’s motion idea. Retry before saving.
motionSavedNote: Saves the idea only. No video is generated and no credits are used.
resetUnknown: The server has not provided a reset time
avatarInvalid: Choose an image within the current upload limits.
resetPolicyNote: This is free-credit policy metadata only. It does not mean video generation will become available then.
